workflow.name: Look up English vocabulary via Telegram and save to Notion
workflow.description: Telegram bot that accepts text, voice, or photo messages; detects input type; transcribes audio via Whisper; extracts text from photos via GPT vision; runs a GPT dictionary agent for vocabulary lookup with spell-check; replies via Telegram; saves to Notion.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for GPT dictionary agent, Whisper, and vision

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for dictionary agent

NOTION_VOCABULARY_DB_ID.description: Notion vocabulary database ID (mocked — saved locally)

TARGET_LANGUAGE.description: Language for translations in dictionary output

MOCK_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.description: Skip real Whisper API; return fixed word instead

workflow_steps.name: Telegram Trigger
workflow_steps.description: Receive an incoming Telegram message (text, voice, or photo)

workflow_steps.name: Authorize User
workflow_steps.description: Compare sender chat ID against authorized TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID; authorized → step 5, unauthorized → step 4

workflow_steps.name: Reject Unauthorized User
workflow_steps.description: Send rejection message to unauthorized sender; end workflow

workflow_steps.name: Detect Input Type
workflow_steps.description: Route by message type: text → step 6, voice → step 7, photo → step 11

workflow_steps.name: Set Text Input
workflow_steps.description: Extract text from the Telegram text message and set as chat_input

workflow_steps.name: Get Voice File
workflow_steps.description: Call Telegram getFile API to resolve voice file_id to file_path

workflow_steps.name: Download Audio
workflow_steps.description: Download the voice audio file from Telegram CDN

workflow_steps.name: Transcribe Audio (Whisper)
workflow_steps.description: Transcribe voice audio to text using OpenAI Whisper

workflow_steps.name: Set Voice Text
workflow_steps.description: Wrap Whisper transcription into chat_input format

workflow_steps.name: Get Photo File
workflow_steps.description: Call Telegram getFile API to resolve photo file_id to file_path

workflow_steps.name: Download Image
workflow_steps.description: Download the photo file from Telegram CDN

workflow_steps.name: Analyze Image
workflow_steps.description: Extract English words from photo using GPT-4o-mini vision OCR

workflow_steps.name: Set Photo Text
workflow_steps.description: Wrap GPT vision output into chat_input format

workflow_steps.name: Dictionary Agent
workflow_steps.description: GPT agent: spell-check input word, return structured vocabulary entry (word, definition, translation, part_of_speech, example_sentence, example_translation)

workflow_steps.name: Send Telegram Reply
workflow_steps.description: Send formatted vocabulary card back to the user via Telegram

workflow_steps.name: Save Vocabulary to Notion
workflow_steps.description: Append vocabulary entry to Notion database (mock: local JSON + CSV)
